negative_reviews.author: Big Jay
negative_reviews.text:
Visited Maki Ramen with my wife and ordered the Steak Tataki, Chicken Yakisoba, and Tiger Roll to start. The food was okay overall, but I was disappointed with the ramen. Ramen did not come with crispy dried seaweed sheets, fish cake, bean sprouts, and sweetcorn.

Considering the bill came to £62 for two people, I expected better quality and quantity. Unfortunately, it didn't feel like good value for money.

Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source).
